description: Shared definitions for Blueprint schema version 1. get_section_schema() inlines these so callers receive a self-contained schema.

businessKey.description: Stable identity of an entry within its section (FR-BP-003). Lowercase first character, dot/underscore/colon/dash separated segments; never reassigned once published.

decisionId.description: Mapping or architecture decision identifier, e.g. MAP-017.

artifactId.description: Reference to an S0 artifact. Blueprint may only reference artifacts, never embed their content (FR-BP-002).

source.description: Provenance of an entry (BP-SCH-005): which artifact and position it came from, and/or which decision produced it.

localizedText.description: A displayable field with translations (FR-COV-009). The default language comes from project.defaultLanguage; a missing translation is a WARNING, not an error.

confidence.description: Agent or user confidence in this entry, 0..1. Below generationPolicy.decisionConfidenceThreshold a decision needs a confirmation record (BP-DEC-004).

confirmation.description: The user confirmation a low-confidence or high-impact decision needs (BP-DEC-004): either the Question that was answered and who answered it, or the operator of the human-authored patch. S2 never creates the Question; it only records the answer.

dhis2Type.description: Logical DHIS2 metadata object type name as registered by a type descriptor (FR-COV-001).

uid.description: DHIS2 object UID. Written by S2 only (P-04, BP-DRF-005.4): a patch carrying this field is rejected.

code.description: Stable human-readable code. S2 generates codes from generationPolicy (FR-REG-008); a code observed on an existing environment object is copied verbatim because binding match relies on it (D-02), so lower case is allowed too.

fieldValues.description: DHIS2 property values for a mapped object. Full metadata JSON must not be pasted in here (FR-BP-002): keys are DHIS2 property names, values are scalars, localizedText, lists of scalars or nested structures of the same shape.

sharing.description: Sharing intention compiled into the target version's sharing format (FR-COV-006).
